query:
SELECT
            ba.id,
            ba.asset_id,
            ba.transaction_id,
            null AS "account: AccountEmbed",
            lower(ba.during) as begins,
            coalesce(upper(ba.during), '+infinity'::timestamp) as "ends!: PgDateTime",
            ba.activated,
            ba.maintenance
        FROM
            bookable_appointments ba LEFT JOIN accounts_people ap ON ba.account_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN account_groups ag ON ba.account_id = ag.id WHERE true AND account_id = $1  AND UPPER(ba.during) <= $2  ORDER BY during LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
